headline: One of the wealthiest Czechs deepened his loss to 276 million. Yet his business is growing
summary: Passerinvest Group increased its loss last year from 64 million to 276 million crowns. Group revenue rose 6% to 1.6 billion crowns, and the developer continues large investments in Brumlovka and Roztyly.
why: Passerinvest is a Czech property developer, and its losses and investment plans indicate the health of the local development market.
